title: KOMHTOM Double Padded Bed with LED Mood Light, Flat Bed with Wooden Slatted Base, Unique Modern Design, PU (without Mattress) (Black, 140 x 200 cm)

feature_bullets: QUALITY MATERIALS: This padded bed features an easy to clean PU leather finish. The bed frame is carefully crafted from MDF to ensure the stability and durability of the bed for a restful sleep.

LIGHTING: The bed is surrounded by LED lights, controlled by a 24-key remote control. You can adjust the color and brightness according to your mood, creating a warm and romantic atmosphere, ideal for reading, watching movies or relaxing.

ELEGANT AND ELEGANT - With its classic white/black design, this bed frame matches a wide range of home decor styles. Whether it is a modern, minimalist or Scandinavian style, it can add a sophisticated touch to your bedroom.
ERGONOMIC DESIGN - This bed features a unique curved design that adds a modern touch to the bedroom. The well-designed headboard provides great support so you can lean back comfortably.

QUICK AND EASY ASSEMBLY: This bed is designed to be easy to assemble and comes with clear, step-by-step instructions that you can follow to complete assembly quickly. Due to the large size of this product, it is shipped in 2 packages and may arrive on different dates. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
